text:
maria: Quick Q for product/security — customer asked for a 'KMS attestation matrix' to show how BYOK interop meets SOC2/ISO. What exactly do they expect? cc @deepak @sam
deepak: Do they want a mapping of controls -> evidence artifacts, or something procedural (steps to onboard keys)?

maria: They emailed 'attestation showing KMS key lifecycle, separation of duties, and proof of access restrictions per tenant'. Seems more control->evidence mapping + config snippets.

sam: From security side, we typically provide: key ownership diagram, KMS policy examples, KMS audit log slices, and a signed attestation from infra. Also metadata: rotation cadence, HSM vs KMS, exportability. Can we reuse the SOC2 pack?

jessica: We have a checklist in /docs/internal/kms-onboard.md but it assumes our managed KMS. For BYOK we need a sample key policy and the handshake flow: `create -> escrow -> rotate -> revoke` steps. Example snippet: ```json {"action":"create_key","attrs":{"purpose":"tenant-encryption","origin":"external-kms"}} ```

maria: Legal asked for something machine-readable for their auditors. They prefer a matrix CSV with columns: control_id, requirement, artifact_link, owner, sample_query. Any objections?

patrick: CSV is fine. Also need a statement of responsibility per control (who signs). Include SLA language for key availability and an attestation that key material is never exported.

deepak: OK plan: assemble draft matrix + sample artifacts + one-pager attestation template. Who owns each piece?

sam: Security will own artifacts/list + sample audit logs. Infra (jessica) owns key lifecycle flow + sample policies. Product (maria) will coordinate and own the CSV + narrative.

jessica: ETA: draft artifacts by Tue EOD (3 days). I'll attach sample key policy snippet and handshake sequence.

maria: Two quick follow-ups: 1) do we need to run a test with a customer's KMS vendor to capture actual logs? 2) who signs the attestation (VP Sec or CTO)?

sam: 1) Yes — recommend one vendor test run with a customer tenant to capture real audit slices. 2) Security prefers VP Sec + Legal on the signature.

ops-bot: Task created: KMS-attestation-test for customer 'GammaCorp' due in 3 days. owner=@ops-runbooks link: https://tasks.example/1234

patrick: I'll draft attestation language and share for signoff. If anything around exportability comes up we'll add an escalation path.

maria: Thanks team — I'll compile CSV template and ping for review on Thu. :thumbsup:
